landing.heroSubtitle: Design high-converting, adaptive forms with conditional branching, AI-driven form generation, real-time OTP verification, and enterprise-grade security.
landing.aiDescription: Generate production-ready multi-step forms in seconds from a simple prompt.
landing.feature1Desc: Create intelligent forms that adapt in real time. Show, hide, or require fields dynamically based on responses.
landing.feature2Desc: Strict type, range, regex, and file size checks guarantee that only clean, compliant data enters your database.
landing.feature3Desc: Ensure verified respondents and prevent spam with instant 6-digit email OTP verification codes.
landing.feature4Desc: Describe any form in natural language and let Google Gemini / Sarvam AI generate full schemas with rules in seconds.
landing.feature5Desc: Generate tamper-proof single-use links that automatically lock out respondents after a single submission.
landing.feature6Desc: Inspect submissions in real time, filter by fields, and download full datasets in standard CSV and JSON.
landing.howItWorksSubheading: From initial prompt to live data collection in three simple steps.
landing.step1Desc: Use the visual drag-and-drop builder or type an AI prompt to compose your form structure and conditional branching.
landing.step2Desc: Publish your version with a single click and distribute via public links or authenticated single-use tokens.
landing.step3Desc: Respondents verify their email with real-time OTP, submit answers, and receive automated email receipts.
landing.ctaSubheading: Join thousands of builders collecting clean, validated data with dynamic conditional logic and AI automation.
landing.prob1Desc: Static forms cannot adapt to what users enter.
landing.prob2Desc: Bad data creates problems long after submission.
landing.prob3Desc: Responses should be easy to manage.
landing.storySubtitle: Build structured forms in minutes, then control exactly how they behave.
landing.logicSubtitle: Show, hide, or require fields based on what your users enter.
landing.validationSubtitle: Every submission is checked on the server against the rules you configured, so bad data never reaches your response table.
landing.wf1Desc: Simple inbound enquiries routed into one response inbox.
landing.wf2Desc: Collect attendee details with age and eligibility rules.
landing.wf3Desc: Multi-field applications with documents and file uploads.
landing.wf4Desc: Structured ratings and comments, ready for CSV export.
landing.footerTagline: Enterprise dynamic form infrastructure and data collection platform.
